candidate_evidence.quote: LP-184: LP-184 is a small molecule alkylating agent causing tumor cell death through DNA damage.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have a histologically or cytologically documented advanced solid tumor that has relapsed from or is refractory to standard treatment, or for which no standard treatment is available.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To characterize the PK of LP-184 and its metabolites in plasma by assessing the peak plasma concentration (Cmax)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the RP2D of LP-184 based on all available safety (graded by CTCAE v5.0), PK, PD and efficacy data

role_evidence.quote: Patients who meet all eligibility criteria will be enrolled to receive treatment with LP-184 at a dose determined based on the available cohort at the time of each patient's enrollment.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational small-molecule alkylating agent (acylfulvene-class DNA-damaging agent)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: LP-184 is a small molecule alkylating agent causing tumor cell death through DNA damage.

role_evidence.quote: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with Hormone Receptor (HR)-Negative and HER2-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) to evaluate the safety, tolerability and clinical activity of LP-184 in combination with olaparib

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: A poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor that impairs homologous recombination (HR) dependent DNA damage repair by trapping PARP1/2 on DNA, leading to synthetic lethality in BRCA1/2-deficient cells.

role_evidence.quote: to evaluate the safety, tolerability and clinical activity of LP-184 in combination with nivolumab and ipilimumab

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: By blocking the PD-1 receptor on the surface of T cells, Nivolumab restores immune cells' ability to recognize and attack cancer cells.

role_evidence.quote: to evaluate the safety, tolerability and clinical activity of LP-184 in combination with nivolumab and ipilimumab

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: By blocking the CTLA4 protein on the surface of T cells, Ipilimumab activates T-cells and allows T-cells to attack cancer cells.

source_quote.quote: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with triple negative breast cancer (TNBC), non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or other solid tumours with known DDR genomic alterations

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; GBM named in conditions and in eligibility (KPS for GBM patients). LP-184 is monotherapy in the Master Protocol (dose escalation, the arm GBM patients can enter) and Supplement A; it is combined with olaparib (Supplement C, TNBC only) and nivolumab + ipilimumab (Supplement D, NSCLC only), where its role would be experimental_combination. Regimen coded monotherapy for the GBM-eligible arms; if all arms are counted it would be combination with olaparib, nivolumab, ipilimumab. Olaparib, nivolumab and ipilimumab cohorts exclude GBM. control_arm_from_other_arms = no: several experimental cohorts, none a control. PK is plasma only. 'PD data' listed in the RP2D outcome but no specific PD measure, so target engagement unclear. PTGR1 overexpression is mentioned for preferential (not required) enrolment and profiling; not coded as matched because the record does not state a link to LP-184. KEAP1/STK11 and PD-L1-low enrichment apply to the NSCLC cohort only; PD-L1 matched to nivolumab (PD-1/PD-L1 axis) - note PD-L1-low is selection against high expression. HR/HER2-negative breast cancer (Supplement C) not coded as a molecular biomarker.
